skills.name: architecture-review
skills.description: Assess a codebase's structure - module boundaries, dependency direction, layering and coupling - and report violations with evidence.

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: Review a set of code changes for correctness, tests, readability and adherence to project standards, reporting findings by severity.

skills.name: domain-modeling
skills.description: Build or sharpen the domain model - ubiquitous language, bounded contexts, aggregates and invariants - and record it as reviewable markdown.

skills.name: engineering-router
skills.description: Recommend the engineering skill that fits a goal (research, grilling, modelling, design, TDD, implementation, review, architecture) using each skill's declared triggers.

skills.name: grilling
skills.description: Stress-test a plan, design or decision by asking hard questions one at a time until its assumptions and risks are explicit.

skills.name: implementation
skills.description: Implement a scoped change end to end - plan the steps, make small verified edits, and leave the build and tests green.

skills.name: improve-codebase-architecture
skills.description: Improve the structure of a codebase in small, behaviour-preserving steps - deepen shallow modules, fix dependency direction, reduce coupling.

skills.name: interface-design
skills.description: Design a small, deep public interface (API, trait, module boundary) and its contract tests before any implementation exists.

skills.name: research
skills.description: Answer a technical question from high-trust primary sources (official docs, specs, source code) and record the findings with citations.

skills.name: setup-agentos
skills.description: First-run setup for AgentOS. Check whether the CLI is installed, initialize the current project, and explain permissions without overwriting user files.

skills.name: tdd
skills.description: Test-driven development - write a failing test first, make it pass with the smallest change, then refactor, one behaviour at a time.
